etsy.title: Gravel Legend Rally Art Print, Vintage Style Motorsport Poster, Hairpin Road Arrow, Rally Car Gift
etsy.description:
Gravel Legend, est. first hairpin: a rally art print with a retro road-arrow graphic for the driver who peaked on the loose stuff.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a garage, man cave, home office, or on a rally fan's wall.

Generic rally design: no team, series, or manufacturer marks.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy "gravel" art searches are mostly gravel cycling prints; pairing gravel with rally keeps this listing in the motorsport results.
Gravel-stage rally prints shown are real-car paintings and a typographic gravel stage racing poster; none use a humorous "legend" angle.
Amazon rally prints are real-car watercolors and paintings sold unframed in 8x10, 11x14, A3, and A2, pitched at garages and man caves.
Amazon titles stack plain words: "wall art", "unframed", "gift for car enthusiast"; no pace-note or co-driver humor prints seen.

research.notes: Lead pairs the printed "Gravel Legend" with indexed "rally art"; "vintage rally poster" kept second because a sibling (Driveway Rallye 77) is the more obviously retro design. Listing pages were not reachable (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results and research/keywords/rally.json only. No priceRange: snippets did not reliably separate physical prints from digital downloads.
